title: Stale epoch-semantics comments in channel_select doc and tx has_key justification
description: link.h:459-476 lichan_link_channel_select calls epoch 'PHY time sync value from link context' derived 'from link-layer time synchronization state' - post r1vn doctrine epoch is key-rotation counter only (may legitimately enter CHANNEL hash per spec/02a:193, unlike SLOT hash). lichen_link_tx.c:64-66 justification cites freezing epoch-derived slot that load_key would rotate - post 2m3o slots derive from SFN-0 not epoch so mechanism cited no longer exists (ordering still correct). Reword both.
close_reason: Both stale-justification comments reworded. (1) link.h channel_select doc block: now states epoch is the key-rotation counter from the link context, NOT a PHY time-sync value; spec/02a:193 defines SelectChannel Data = CONCAT(EUI64 BE, Epoch LE u32) so the epoch MAY enter the CHANNEL hash, and the MUST-NOT-enter prohibition applies to the SLOT hash (§2a.2 Slot=(fnv1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN)) mod n); @param epoch updated to 'key-rotation counter from link context'; also fixed the stale :120 pseudocode anchor to :190 (actual SelectChannel procedure location; old :120 lands in 2a.5.1 signature text). (2) lichen_link_tx.c has_key-first justification: removed the false 'must not freeze an epoch-derived slot that load_key() would immediately rotate' mechanism (slots now derive from the SFN-0 baseline; load_key does not rotate slots). Read the actual code first: lichen_tdma_init consumes NO crypto RNG and no keys - it only hashes ctx->eui64 against SFN-0 (lichen_hash_32 is pure FNV-1a; the only CSPRNG use in the ctx lifecycle is lichen_link_init's initial-epoch draw). The bead's suggested 'tdma init consumes crypto RNG context availability' rationale is not supported by the code, so per the bead's own '(read code, state actual dependency)' instruction the comment states the true dependency: init graph ordering (AGENTS.md load_key precedes tdma_init) preserved by construction, keeping an unkeyed context fail-fast -ENOKEY before any TDMA latch/schedule state is created on it. Ordering behavior unchanged (gate already sat below has_key). Verified: clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra on lichen_link_tx.c and link_ctx.c exit 0 (same stub-header stand-ins: CONFIG defines + Kconfig default MAX_NEIGHBORS=16 + EBUSY); harness + python cross-check re-run green.
